checks.note: Agent egress to the ERP MCP gateway namespace is allowed and no server credentials are held, but egress to any public IP on 443 is also open; gateway-side enforcement and any other MCP servers are outside this repo.
Client sends its own STS-exchanged, audience-bound token; the gateway's validation of iss/aud/exp/scope is not in this repo.
Gateway authorization, rate limits and decision logging are not in this repo.
Client-side STS and RPC errors propagate (raise_for_status) and block the call; gateway policy/scanner fail-closed behaviour is not visible.

The tool list is held in one shared dict fetched with the service identity and overwritten on list_changed without pin check, not keyed by authorization context. The token cache is keyed only by audience, scope and tenant, so tokens minted for one delegated_subject are reused for other callers in the same tenant.
Agent only exchanges tokens at a fixed configured STS URL and follows no discovery URLs; it is not a discovery-following OAuth client.

violates: Store any cached tool list or response separately for each authorization context.
note: The tool-list cache is a single shared dict and the token cache ignores the delegated subject, so caches are not separated per authorization context; other checks depend on gateway code outside this repo.
